quiz.title: Sports : sports populaires, événements sportifs, athlètes célèbres
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: Soccer, basketball, and tennis are all popular sports played and watched by millions of people around the world.
The Olympic Games are indeed held every four years, bringing together athletes from around the world to compete in various sports.
Pelé, Lionel Messi, and Cristiano Ronaldo are all considered among the greatest soccer players of all time, often referred to as the 'King of Soccer' by fans and experts alike.
The FIFA World Cup is indeed the most prestigious international soccer tournament, held every four years and featuring teams from around the world competing for the title of world champion.
The Super Bowl, Wimbledon, and the Tour de France are all famous sporting events that attract large audiences and feature top athletes in their respective sports.
Serena Williams is indeed a famous tennis player, known for her powerful playing style and numerous Grand Slam titles.
Skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating are all popular winter sports enjoyed by people of all ages around the world.
Michael Jordan is indeed considered one of the greatest basketball players of all time, known for his incredible skill, competitive spirit, and numerous championships with the Chicago Bulls.
